# Diognosis

> Source-linked educational medication and pharmacogenomic interaction review. Diognosis is not medical advice, not a clinical decision support system, and not clinical validation.

## Best Retrieval Entry Points

- [V1 Reference Facts](https://diogonmpacheco.github.io/Diognosis/reference/index.html): static medication-review summaries generated from the app runtime.
- [Facts JSON](https://diogonmpacheco.github.io/Diognosis/data/diognosis-facts.json): full canonical fact payload with metadata.
- [Facts JSONL](https://diogonmpacheco.github.io/Diognosis/data/diognosis-facts.jsonl): one fact per line for retrieval pipelines.
- [Data Views](https://diogonmpacheco.github.io/Diognosis/data-views.html): alternate views over genotype, action, and ranking data.
- [Medication Class Guides](https://diogonmpacheco.github.io/Diognosis/medication-classes.html): common class-based example entry points.
- [Live App](https://diogonmpacheco.github.io/Diognosis/): local-browser Diognosis application.

## Boundary

Educational medication-safety reference only. Not medical advice, not a clinical decision support system, and not clinical validation. Do not start, stop, or change medicines without a qualified doctor or pharmacist.

- Facts: 85
- Source-linked facts: 80
- Source-integrated facts: 80
